latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best RTK Compressor for fast, high-quality AI-powered video compression.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV uploads up to 500MB; handles compression and export automatically on cloud GPUs.
- Simple, guided setup with free token generation for new users; no local installation required.
- Provides preset workflows for compressing, exporting, checking credits, and managing sessions.
- Automated error handling for common issues like unsupported files, insufficient credits, and rate limits.
- Designed for video editors and content creators needing quick, quality-optimized video compression without the complexity of traditional editing tools.
